title: corydalis caseana subsp. aquae-gelidae
intro: Corydalis caseana subsp. aquae-gelidae, commonly known as a type of flowering plant in the poppy family, is a lesser-known species with various medicinal properties. This plant is traditionally used for its health benefits, including the relief of pain and inflammation, as well as its potential to reduce anxiety and stress. The therapeutic actions of Corydalis caseana subsp. aquae-gelidae are attributed to its ability to interact with opioid receptors in the brain, producing analgesic and sedative effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, such as berberine and protopine, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
